title: Telemetry-driven post-deploy pressure probe: API readiness + model load validation
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Add a telemetry-driven post-deploy validation harness that performs incremental pressure tests and API readiness probes for Private (VPC) deployments. The goal is a reproducible, automated routine that runs after terraforming and service start to validate: 1) API handshake and auth flows, 2) model weights load and KV cache priming, 3) smoke inference correctness, and 4) gradual load pressure to expose regressions in autoscaler, OOMs, or model initialization failures. This ticket covers the orchestration, runbook, thresholds, and dashboard wiring; separate infra tasks exist for terraform module updates.
acceptance_criteria: Automated probe run finishes with PASS/FAIL status emitted to deploy pipeline and Slack channel
API readiness endpoint returns 200 and completes auth handshake in >=95% of attempts within 30s during low-pressure mode
Model load phase succeeds for target model family (gpt-medium-quant) on Private nodes with success rate >=98% across 5 runs
Smoke inference returns expected structured output for 10 prompts (sanity set) with <=1 unexpected error
Pressure test ramp shows no memory OOMs and stable tail latency under configured thresholds; failure conditions produce descriptive alert reasons
Runbook includes remediation steps and an automated rollback trigger when >2 critical checks fail
tasks: Design telemetry thresholds and success criteria (SRE + runtime)
Implement probe orchestrator script (idempotent) to run in post-deploy pipeline
Add model-load verifier that watches container logs and checks KV cache priming metrics
Create smoke test suite and minimal prompt set with deterministic expected tokens/structure
Implement pressure ramp sequence: baseline -> 5qps -> 20qps -> 50qps (or until failure) with timeboxed stages
Wire probe results to deploy pipeline and alerting channel; add dashboard panels for probe runs
Document runbook and failure modes; include rollback guard and canary fallback instructions
test_plan: Step 0: Preflight - ensure terraform apply completed and service health endpoint exists
Step 1: Auth check - run 30 concurrent token handshakes to validate IAM/KMS integration
Step 2: Load model - trigger model instantiate API and tail logs for 'model_loaded' marker; repeat 5 times
Step 3: KV cache validation - issue repeated prefix prompts, confirm cache hit rate increases via telemetry
Step 4: Smoke inference - run 10 deterministic prompts and validate structure and confidence thresholds
Step 5: Pressure ramp - ramp qps across stages for 3 minutes each, record p50/p95/p99 and memory metrics
Step 6: Post-check - validate no process restarts, no OOM events, and disk I/O normalcy
Step 7: Report - produce JSON summary artifact and publish to pipeline artifacts and dashboard
